desc:
🛒 You walked into Supermarket... and the Doors LOCKED!! Nobody buys anything, so MR YUMMY wants to turn YOU into food to SELL!!😨

🏆 5 GAME MODES to beat!! Not just Easy and Hard

😱 Sneak past Mr Yummy while he sleeps... He NEVER closes his eyes 👀
🥫 Blast MRS YUMMY with the KETCHUP BAZOOKA in an EPIC BOSS BATTLE!
🍔 Run from Spilled Milk, Flying Tomatoes and Killer Burgers
🧊 Survive the MEAT FREEZER & the Giant Ham!

🪙 25 hidden tokens in EVERY mode (125 total) CAN YOU FIND THEM ALL??

👥 Play with Friends and RACE for 1st on Leaderboard!
⚡ Unlock MORPHS, Jetpack, Flying Cloud and Grapple Gun
📱 Playable on Mobile, Tablet, PC & Console

⚠️ Contains mild Jumpscares

⭐ LIKE + FAVORITE - new UPD at 10K LIKES!

🎧 ASMR vibes included
Satisfying caramel keyboard clicks with every step for the perfect mix of chase & chill ✨

A mega fun Escape Story Obby set in a huge Grocery Store: run the scary Parkour, dodge Traps and Giant Food, escape the Evil Manager, Speedrun your fastest time
